# Vendored from pstack

Lauren Tan's (poteto) pstack, https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/2f87c854fe3e2fcda44ca86b46ede35aad3c46b7/pstack, MIT (see LICENSE).
Copied unmodified at commit `2f87c854fe3e2fcda44ca86b46ede35aad3c46b7`. Each `principle-*.md` is that skill's `SKILL.md`.

The simplify reviewer's instructions (`prompts/simplify.md`) include these principles verbatim. Its list of
comments worth keeping is adapted from pstack's `agents/comment-sicko.md`.

To update: re-fetch the same paths at a newer commit, then re-run the simplify eval before shipping.
